topography.project_purpose: This brief describes the observed EVM deployment and audit surface for Ring Protocol. It intentionally limits the description to receipted repository and on-chain evidence instead of inferring a business model.
topography.relationship_narrative: The pinned logic-topography run contains 22 contract row(s) across arbitrum, avalanche, base, blast, bsc, celo, ethereum, hyperliquid, ink, megaeth, optimism, polygon, unichain, zora. Structural roles: 9 core, 7 supporting, 6 unclassified. No upgradeable pattern was identified in these rows.
